description: Standard product specifications, seller ecosystem, catalog details, and dynamic database retrieval directives.

runtime_data_directive.important_rule: Static knowledge only provides descriptive profiles, ingredients, and baseline reference data. Current live product prices, actual stock levels, active discounts, and in-stock flags MUST be retrieved from the active MySQL database at runtime using product queries. Never fabricate or hallucinate real-time stock quantities or changing prices.
